title: The 9 Best Smart Pet Water Fountains
subtitle: Wi-Fi pet fountains with low-water and filter alerts, ranked.
intro: We pulled the smart pet water fountains on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: wireless pumps, capacity, drinking tracking, and app alerts.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

scoring.review_age_weighting: Listings under 24 months old with at least 30 reviews have their review count multiplied by min(2, 24 / age in months, age floored at 6) before scoring; older listings are unchanged. Listing age is Amazon's Date First Available, or an estimate from the ASIN when the listing does not show it.

awards.label: Best Overall
awards.name: PETLIBRO Dockstream 2 Cordless (3 L)
awards.why: PETLIBRO's cordless Dockstream 2 weighs every sip and runs up to a month per charge, rated 4.2 stars by 4,617 buyers.

awards.name: PETLIBRO Dockstream (2.5 L)

awards.label: Best Premium

systems_note: Smart fountains run in their makers' apps. None of these listings name a voice assistant or smart home platform.

buyers_guide.a: Running water encourages cats to drink more. The smart part adds low-water and filter alerts, and some track how often your pet drinks.
Wireless pumps are powered through the base, so there's no cord in the water, which is safer and easier to clean.

buyers_guide.q: How often do filters need changing?
buyers_guide.a: Usually every two to four weeks, depending on how many pets drink from it. The app reminds you.
